question: On their anniversary Mr. and Mrs. Singh received five gift boxes. They numbered these boxes from one to five as and when they received them. In the evening they opened a box and found a pair of rings in it. They found a dinner set in an even numbered box. The first box sent by Mr. Singh’s sister contained a photo collage and the box which was received as the last box contained a wind chime. They found a beautiful dress in an even numbered box. In which box did they receive a pair of rings?
solution:
Given: On their anniversary Mr. and Mrs. Singh received five gift boxes.

They numbered these boxes from one to five as and when they received them.

In the evening they opened a box and found a pair of rings in it.

1) The first box sent by Mr. Singh’s sister contained a photo collage.

2) The box which was received as the last box contained a wind chime.
